about:
Founded in 2010 in New Orleans, Louisiana, TCI Packaging operates a 550,000-square-foot warehouse at the Port of New Orleans. The facility is dedicated to the pneumatic bulk transfer and packaging of PVC resins and polyolefins for international distribution.

The company provides packaging services that transfer bulk PVC resin and polyethylene pellets into 25-kilogram form-fill-seal bags and bulk bags (Super Sacks) on industry-leading packaging lines, running 24 hours a day, seven days a week. It also offers heavy container drayage, trucking, yard logistics, accounting, and inventory management, combining packaging, storage, and transportation into a single logistics solution.

TCI Packaging serves plastics manufacturers and traders who export resin products worldwide. Its customer base includes producers of PVC and polyethylene resins that require tailored export packaging and logistics support from the Gulf Coast.

The company emphasizes a customer-driven philosophy, tailoring logistics to each client’s needs. Its management team brings a combined 50-plus years of export logistics experience, and the firm operates under a Dream, People, Culture framework that sets quantifiable long-term goals, invests in talent, and maintains a proactive, performance-driven culture.
